mapper.select: SELECT n.id , n.author_id authorId , a.nickname , n.title , n.category , n.digest , n.contents , n.is_publish isPublish , n.created_at createdAt , n.updated_at updatedAt , n.deleted_at deletedAt FROM novels n LEFT JOIN authors a ON n.author_id = a.id WHERE n.is_publish = #{isPublish}
